prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped at a red light in the right lane.
Q: What happened next?
A: I had been stopped for maybe ten seconds when I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped back and my car lurched forward into the intersection.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: No. I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in my mirror after I was hit, and it was a larger pickup truck.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Briefly. He said he was looking at his phone and didn't brake in time. He seemed apologetic.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself on the steering wheel, and my wrist took the force. The pain was immediate. Someone at the scene called an ambulance.
Q: Where were you treated?
A: I was taken to a local emergency room. They took X-rays and told me I had a fracture in my wrist. I was given a splint and told to see a hand specialist.
Q: Have you missed work or had any other treatment since?
A: Yes, I've been unable to drive for work and I've had two follow-up appointments. I'm still in a cast and doing physical therapy when I can.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful to keep all my receipts and medical paperwork, and I'm willing to provide them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
